panels.description: At Site 6, Tomas lies pinned beneath a collapsed hauling frame. Alex stands just outside the painted assignment boundary; leave upper machinery space for the groan.
Alex's identity band flashes the wage-forfeiture warning. Keep his wrist and the boundary stripe clear.
Tomas looks toward Alex from beneath the frame, trying to dismiss the danger. Leave upper space for his line.
Alex crosses the painted boundary and wedges a pry bar under the frame. Make the cause-and-effect silhouette clear and leave upper space for the alarm.
